to Live Stream Pelicans vs. KnicksYou can stream the Pelicans vs. Knicks game live in multiple ways depending on your market.IN-MARKET PELICANS FANSPelicans+ is the most flexible way to watch Pelicans games at home or on the go within 150 miles of New Orleans. For the first time, fans within the local market (defined as the state of Louisiana plus most zip codes within a 150-mile radius of the Smoothie King Center) can watch live and on-demand regular season games from their device.OUT-OF-MARKET PELICANS FANSCatch all the Pelicans action from anywhere! Stream and watch live games with NBA League Pass available on 19 platforms with multiple broadcast options so you can select your preferred viewing experience.Pelicans Pregame & Postgame Live StreamsCatch New Orleans Pelicans interim head coach James Borrego's Pregame and Postgame interviews plus interviews from Pelicans players on various platforms presented by Caesars Sportsbook:Trey Murphy #25 of the New Orleans Pelicans drives to the basket against Phoenix forward Royce O'Neale.Suns 123, Pelicans 114: Trey Murphy 24 points | Postgame wrapSuns (18-13), Pelicans (8-25); Derik Queen 21-11December 27, 20258:35 PM CSTDevin Booker has produced some monumental offensive performances in recent seasons vs. New Orleans. Saturday was not one of those, but the All-Star guard still managed to make multiple critical plays to ruin the night for the Pelicans. After New Orleans closed its deficit to Phoenix to 108-106 in the final minutes, Booker drained a pair of jumpers, then fed Dillon Brooks for a hoop. The 7-0 run gave the Suns a nine-point edge with 1:50 remaining, essentially sealing a second Phoenix win in as many nights on the Smoothie King Center hardwood.It’s difficult for any regular season game to match the intensity of a playoff matchup, but after two head-to-head meetings this weekend, Phoenix vs. New Orleans reached a new level, particularly after a heated altercation between Suns center Mark Williams and Pelicans guard Jose Alvarado in the third quarter. Both players were ejected.On the positive side, Trey Murphy shot 6/9 from beyond the arc and paced the Pelicans with 24 points. Zion Williamson netted 22 points on 8/11 shooting from the field, while rookie Derik Queen compiled his second 20-10 game as a pro, registering 21 points and 11 rebounds.BY THE NUMBERS17: Phoenix offensive rebounds in the first half, a staggering tally that helped the Suns rack up 65 points. The Pelicans got that problem area under control a bit after intermission, but their guests finished with 22 offensive boards.16: New Orleans assists, tied for a season low. The Pelicans were just 9/27 from three-point range. According to James Borrego, they missed 21 layups Saturday, with numerous shots rimming out after attempts to bank in scores.NEXT FOR NEW ORLEANSThe final home game on the 2025 calendar is Monday, with New York paying a visit to the Blender at 7 p.m. By the way, 2026 begins with a Friday home tilt vs. Portland, but much of January will be spent on the road, including a pair of three-game trips, the latter a gauntlet to Memphis, San Antonio and Oklahoma City.NEXT VS.
